gotchas: Delivery needs a 35 dollar order. Below that the bag says to spend more to enable delivery and checkout offers pickup only, which is what makes a cheap single item look like a checkout with no address form. Raise the quantity in the bag with input[aria-label^='Enter quantity of'] and press Enter.

The checkout session expires after about a minute idle, replacing the page with an are-you-still-there message and a Go to bag link, so drive the whole checkout in one sitting and re-enter from the bag on every run.

On the delivery step fill #zipInInput and click Show delivery options before choosing a shipping method, otherwise the later address confirmation bounces back here with a shipping-area-changed message.
The phone field is masked to a national format, so give it ten digits with no country prefix.
The street field is a combobox: fill it, wait about 5 seconds and click a [role=option] if one appears, otherwise press Escape. Both paths validated.
The state select takes two-letter values, and billing same as delivery is checked by default.

After Continue to payment a Confirm your address details prompt appears, comparing what was typed with a normalized version. Click Confirm address and the payment page comes up about 12 seconds later. If the delivery zip field is back instead, redo the shipping and details steps.
The order summary is a table whose last row is the estimated total, and the class name on that row is hashed, so it can move with a deploy. Re-derive it rather than trusting a stored selector.

Credit or Debit card is preselected and the payment widget is already rendered. Card number and security code are cross-origin frames addressed by name, iframe[name='card.number'] and iframe[name='card.cvv'], each holding an input of the same name. Expiry, card holder and the brand select are same-origin in the main document.
notes: Driven locally and through the Agent Vault proxy in September 2026 from the product page to the payment frames: add to bag, the quantity raised past the delivery minimum, Continue as guest, the delivery step, the details form filled field by field, the address confirmation, then the card-number frame counting 1 on the payment page. The card was not filled, so the status is unverified. Every proxy action was accepted first try and the route took about 163 seconds, while the local run reached the same frames in about 70.

overrides.deliveryOption: button[aria-label='Delivery or pick up options, Small Order Shipping']
